author: A Fermie
text:
Really impressed with the job Jack did on my 3 year old Audi before handing it back at the end of a lease.

The car was given a proper top notch clean and detail, and the difference was brilliant. The boot in particular was absolutely hammered after three years of family use, and they somehow managed to get it looking incredibly clean again!

Really professional service, great attention to detail and clearly take pride in what they do. The car looked better than it had in a long time when I collected it. Would definitely recommend and will be using them again.

text:

He's a great lad and obviously knows his trade. I would recommend to anyone. Top job👍

author: Lisa & Martin
text:
I put a posted on Facebook asking for recommendations for a Car Detailing Company. Several people recommended Jack Daniel’s Detailing Company. I contacted Jack who was very helpful, friendly & informative of the products used. We booked both our vehicles in for a 3 year ceramic coating, we are so pleased with the finish on the vehicles & the care shown. Definitely recommend Jack & will be using his services again.
A⭐️⭐️⭐️

text: Booked Jack after seeing what a beautiful job he and his team did on my husband's car. My Mini has now had it's little 'spa day', ready for Spring. They have everything they need in their van, no need to access your water or electricity points. I have no hesitation recommending this hard working business.

text: Jack is reliable and trustworthy. Jack gives great attention to detail, with this amount of detail the car stays cleaner and looks amazing for longer. Great value for money.

text: We booked Jack for a premium valet and he definitely delivered. The car was absolutly immaculate once he had finished and we couldnt be happier. The quality of the work really speaks for itself, and you can tell a lot of care and effort went into it. Super happy with the service and would definitely recommend to anyone looking to give their car a proper refresh.
